description: A malicious actor could impersonate a patient or caregiver to request prescription renewals or access sensitive health information.
An attacker could alter or corrupt the prescription data or patient records, leading to incorrect medication refills or renewals.
A user could deny performing actions, such as requesting a prescription renewal or accessing patient records.
The system could inadvertently or maliciously expose sensitive patient health information to unauthorized parties.
A denial-of-service attack could disrupt the system's ability to send reminders, process renewal requests, or notify patients about their medication readiness.
A user with lower privileges could gain higher access to patient records or system functions, leading to unauthorized actions.
A caregiver could be spoofed, leading to unauthorized access or actions on behalf of the patient.

asset: Patient's medication reminders and renewal requests
description: Sensitive information about the patient's medication reminders and renewal requests could be disclosed to unauthorized parties.
